These pages are served by [Doqs](https://github.com/Andersseen/doqs) on Analog: Markdown becomes prerendered routes, a sidebar, search and previous/next links. Quartz owns the brand and the examples.

> [!NOTE]
> Source blocks on this page are read from the repository at build time (`doq content generate`) and are never executed. The authored file lives in `src/authoring/docs`.

## Live examples are real primitives

A `::playground[id]` or `::demo[id]` line renders a standalone Angular component that uses the actual Quartz directives. The Select playground wraps `qzSelect` and exposes `multiple`, `closeOnSelect`, `disabled`, groups and RTL as Doqs controls:

:::code select-playground.ts

```ts
readonly multiple = input(false);
readonly disabled = input(false);
readonly closeOnSelect = input(false);
readonly grouped = input(true);
readonly rtl = input(false);
```

[View source](https://github.com/Andersseen/quartz/blob/main/src/app/docs-playgrounds/select-playground.ts#L119-L123)

## The async guard is source-backed

The Combobox guide shows [`createLatestRequest`](/docs/reference/api/primitives/create-latest-request). This is the implementation it documents:

:::code combobox-request.ts

```ts
export function createLatestRequest(): LatestRequest {
  let current: AbortController | null = null;
  const cancel = (): void => {
    current?.abort();
    current = null;
  };
  inject(DestroyRef).onDestroy(cancel);
  return {
    cancel,
    async run<R>(task: (signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<R>): Promise<R | undefined> {
      current?.abort();
      const controller = new AbortController();
      current = controller;
      try {
        const result = await task(controller.signal);
        return controller.signal.aborted ? undefined : result;
      } catch (error) {
        if (controller.signal.aborted) return undefined;
        throw error;
      } finally {
        if (current === controller) current = null;
      }
    },
  };
}
```

[View source](https://github.com/Andersseen/quartz/blob/main/packages/primitives/src/combobox/combobox-request.ts#L21-L45)
